TRUMP 대통령Dick Morris: "2025년 11월 McLaughlin의 월간 여론조사에서 귀하의 직업 지지율은 항상 47~50%였습니다. 저는 50년간의 여론 조사에서 그런 것을 본 적이 없습니다. 거의 모든 정치인이 매달 그의 숫자가 오르락내리락하는 것을 보지만 당신은 그렇지 않습니다. 당신은 대중 투표에서 49.8%로 2024년 선거에서 승리했으며 이번 달에 실시된 최신 McLaughlin 여론 조사에서 당신은 49%의 직업 승인 - 당신의 투표율과 똑같습니다. 다른 어떤 정치인도 그의 평가에서 이 정도의 일관성을 갖지 못했습니다. 이란 전쟁과 가스 가격의 상승과 하락을 통해 당신의 직업 승인은 결코 변하지 않습니다.
items.ti_en: The Polls have ALWAYS underestimated MAGA. They try to suppress the Vote, but I won all 7 Swing States, the Popular Vote, 86% of Counties, and 99% of Primaries this year. I AM ON THE BALLOT! President DONALD J. TRUMPFrom Dick Morris: “Since November of 2025 in monthly polls by McLaughlin, your job approval rating has always been between 47 and 50 percent. I have never seen anything like that in fifty years of polling. Almost every politician sees his numbers rise and fall each month but not you. You won the election in 2024 with 49.8 percent of the popular vote and the latest McLaughlin Poll, taken this month, has your job approval at 49% - the exact same as your vote share. No other political figure has ever had this level of consistency in his ratings. Through the Iran War and gas price rises and falls, your job approval is the same. It never changes. And 49% is enough to win - look at how that level of vote won in 2024! In the same Mclaughlin Poll, the generic ballot is 50-48 Democrat. That is also enough to keep the House Republican. Past history indicates that anything less than a four point margin for Democrats likely points to a Republican House victory. And almost all polls are showing Republican gains in the generic ballot.”
